request_text:
Gate P4-G1 was reviewed by Test Tech Lead (decision event 6, 2026-11-17T18:00:22+00:00) and changes were requested: Test decisions (they resolve the blocking findings). GT-29: rows sharing a phone are loaded as separate members and flagged shared (PRD FR-032, ASM-016); defer US-052.AC2 (merge into one member) with this decision as the reason, and keep every task and test aligned with load-and-flag. GT-30: same decision; defer US-050.AC2 (combine same-phone rows) and align its tasks and tests with load-and-flag. GT-42: WhatsApp payment receipt messages are out of scope (PRD section 3, A-005); defer US-023.AC2 and US-023.AC3, plan no task that sends receipt or payment confirmation messages, and do not depend on a consent field for this story. GT-58: follow PRD FR-035; history stays on the archived member record and the kept member links to it (no re-pointing of history rows); plan the tasks and hours for that. GT-20: sign-up collects name, phone and home branch only (FR-008, PD-007, contract SignupStart); no email or plan in sign-up.

These inputs changed since your last run: pack:task-breakdown/validator/system_prompt.md. Update your output to match them and change only what needs changing.
agent_reply: Backlog: backlog/backlog.json and backlog/backlog.md. 55 stories, 173 tasks, 188 story points (5 of 55 stories generated, the rest unchanged). 0 blocking issues, 34 warnings.

gaps: {"rule": "review", "severity": "blocking", "item_ids": ["GT-58-T03"], "message": "Contradicts US-055.AC2 and the architecture. AC2 says the duplicate's payments and check-ins appear on the kept record, but T03 only adds read-time linking for payment history and check-in lists. The architecture and PRD FR-035 say history stays with the archived member, so the task as written needs both reconciled. Keep the no-rows-moved rule and state in the task which reads (payment history, check-in list) must include the archived member's rows. Also split the cross-module work in cmp-member-registry, cmp-payments and cmp-checkin from the phone lookup change, or raise the hours. 10h at low confidence for three modules is tight."}

{"rule": "review", "severity": "blocking", "item_ids": ["GT-65-T01"], "message": "AC1 needs a recorded status \"delivered\", but the Reminder status enum has no such value and the task does not decide where it is held. Update the task to name the field and the contract change, for example adding a delivery status value or a separate delivery field. State whether a delivery failure is final or counts toward the FR-038 3-retries-per-day rule. Add this decision to the story open questions, since it cannot be built or tested without it."}
verdict.summary: Deterministic checks passed (28 warnings) over 55 stories. Reviewed 40 flagged items in 29 stories: 2 blocking, 33 warnings for the Tech Lead. GT-15-T02: Hours depend on the undecided reset delivery channel and trigger (open question in PRD/story notes). Keep the delivery step behind one interface as written, add the new reset operations to api-gym-api-v1, and re-estimate once the channel is decided.; GT-25-T01: Low-confidence estimate rests on open decisions: how long an unconfirmed order blocks a new one, and how the app finds the open order (the contract has no such operation). Settle both before build, and note that PD-011 in the AC is a dashboard definition in the PRD, not a payment rule.; GT-20: Effort mismatch: 5 points (30 h) against only 14 h of tasks. The Join form drops email and plan per a reviewer decision, which conflicts with US-013.AC1/AC2/AC4. The FE task lists no BE task and depends on GT-19-T02. Confirm the three-field decision is recorded as deferred criteria and that the sign-up endpoints come from another story. Resize the points or add the missing work.; GT-14: Total hours (41 h) exceed 5 points (30 h) but the tasks are coherent. The open question on whether the staff_user table or sign-in already exists elsewhere could shrink T01 and T03. Confirm ownership with GT-15 before sprint planning.; GT-27: Story is 2 points (about 12 h) but tasks total 9 h, so the effort is within a reasonable range; no change needed beyond confirming. The FE task depends on GT-26-T01 for GET /me/membership; confirm it exists. Wording for days_left 0 and no-plan members is an open question to settle with the product team.; GT-30-T02: 14 h with low confidence is plausible for the import command. The Excel column layout, plan-name mapping and phone normalisation are open questions that could change the estimate. Get a sample Excel file before starting and re-estimate. Build load-and-flag only, as the deferred US-050.AC2 decision records.; GT-30: 3 points (about 18 h) against 26 h of tasks. The gap comes from the 3,000-member performance test in GT-30-T03 and the low-confidence import. Tech Lead should confirm the size or re-point the story. Do not drop work. AC2 is deferred by decision, so no finding on it.; GT-31: 3 points (about 18 h) but tasks total 11 h, so the tasks look light. The import logic for plan, expiry and branch is carried by GT-30-T02 and the QA task relies on it. Confirm that task covers the three values and the missing-plan flag, and check whether the flag column already exists (open question in GT-31-T02).; GT-32: 3 points (about 18 h) but tasks total 33 h. GT-32-T01 (12 h) and the FE (10 h) look heavy for phone lookup. Part of the lookup and check-in endpoints is shared with GT-33 and GT-34 and the check-in table may already exist in the base schema. Tech Lead should trim or re-point the story.; GT-33: 8 points (about 48 h) but tasks total 28 h, so the story looks over-pointed, or work such as the desk payment link is missing. Confirm the size with the Tech Lead. Also confirm that entered_expired is the stored value for AC2 (open question in GT-33-T01).
